easier.text: neither target was shown to be more predictable than the other beyond its baselines (H1: INCONCLUSIVE (UNDERPOWERED); H2: INCONCLUSIVE; H3: INCONCLUSIVE (UNDERPOWERED); H4: EQUIVALENT); the baseline sets differ: the log SF set contains the prior model G14_ZERO, the log D set no prior model.

pat.text: None of A, B or C (gen13 tree_pipeline: SimpleImputer(median, keep_empty_features=True) then ExtraTreesRegressor(400 trees, random_state = fold.model_seed) on LEAN209 + METAL_BASIC2, configurations K1-K4 (min_samples_leaf 8, 8, 2, 2; max_features 0.3, 0.5, 0.3, 0.5) selected per outer fold on inner data) was shown to beat its pre-named training-only baselines under design BP (H1: INCONCLUSIVE (UNDERPOWERED), H2: INCONCLUSIVE, H3: INCONCLUSIVE (UNDERPOWERED)). This does not show that either target is unpredictable.

h4.text: H4 (EQUIVALENT): the two routes are equivalent within ±0.02 log10.
